world_model_delta: Score tiebreak order: (1) higher quest_score wins; (2) if still tied, higher resource_score; (3) if still tied, faction who reached current score first by turn number. If all three tie, result is DRAW. No external judge for tiebreaks.
validator_question: Are all tiebreak conditions resolvable from game state without external judge?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: LOW — tiebreak is deterministic from game history
